corrections.reason: The printed glyph in Col 3 L08 clearly has the 2nd-order horizontal right-leg stroke of ሁ (ሁንኩ, archaic Andemta form of ሆንኩ), not ሆ.

Both visual inspection of Col 3 L19 (showing the two legs of ሂ rather than single-stem ኒ) and the Amharic translation in L20 ('አይቶም' where '-ም' translates the Ge'ez enclitic '-ሂ') confirm the canonical Ge'ez Gospel reading 'ወርእየሂ ወተፈሥሐ'.
